identity.name: OpenAI Agents SDK
identity.one_liner: Lightweight Python framework for building multi-agent workflows with handoffs, tools, tracing, and guardrails.
identity.short_description: OpenAI Agents SDK is an MIT-licensed Python framework for building agent workflows that can use tools, hand off between agents, trace execution, and apply guardrails.

positioning.why_it_matters: It matters because many builders want an official, small-footprint agent framework rather than a large orchestration stack. It is especially relevant when the agent workflow already uses OpenAI models and APIs.
best_for: Developers building multi-agent workflows in Python
Teams that want tracing and guardrails close to the agent runtime
Builders comparing small agent frameworks against LangGraph, CrewAI, and smolagents
not_for: Teams that need a model-agnostic orchestration platform from day one
Users looking for a no-code agent product
